saints.name: St. Mamertus
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The Bishop of Vienne in Gaul who instituted the Rogation Days of penitential prayer and procession…
biography: Mamertus was Archbishop of Vienne in southern Gaul in the fifth century, a time of earthquakes, fires, and other calamities that struck his region. To turn away these afflictions he appointed three days of fasting, litanies, and processions before the feast of the Ascension.
This observance, the Rogation Days, spread throughout the Western Church and endured for many centuries. He died about 475, remembered chiefly as the author of these public prayers.
saints.knownFor: Instituting the Rogation Days of prayer and procession.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 11 May
